meta.name: Rayavalasa
meta.description: Raju, a kind-hearted young man who lives with his grandmother, cherishes his friendships and leads a simple life while carrying the emotional burden of his parents' tragic past. His peaceful world takes an unexpected turn when Rani, the village president's daughter, returns from the city with a dream of establishing a school for the village children. As their destinies become intertwined, long-standing political rivalries, jealousy, ego, and hidden agendas begin to disrupt the harmony of the village.
